scope: General HEAD/full-reference reflog deletion, snapshot/ref/selection guards, source confirmation text/default buttons and retained stash Drop/Clear semantics. Partial parity; full port remains incomplete.

verification.core: Six ReferenceLogTests passed. New real-Git HEAD reverse-index deletion and whole branch-log deletion leave references/index intact and the other log unchanged; stale snapshots, cross-reference/empty/invalid selectors and malformed refs reject before deletion. Existing distinct selectors/Unicode, stash multi-Drop, stale Drop/Clear and empty-reference tests passed.
verification.native: System Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0 passed. Source singular/multiple confirmation text, Abort retention, empty/invalid/busy and non-stash Clear guards; actual HEAD reverse-index deletion; stale-after-prompt and changed-reference rejection; whole branch-log removal without moving HEAD/index/config/worktree; stash multi-Drop/Clear and chooser mutation guard. Actual hidden NSAlerts verify Delete/Abort button order and Delete-vs-Clear default buttons. No displayed prompts or physical clicks.
verification.iterations: Initial six Core tests and Debug passed. Shared selection error text was made general rather than stash-only; Core and Debug repeated against final sources. Native four-Git matrix and Store/audits passed first run. Earlier passing logs retained; no failed iteration.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified; Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and real fixture operations. EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: RefLog parity and pinned source inventory updated. NOTICE attribution added. Inventory pin and seven-column CSV validation passed; local documentation site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Native deletion receiver added to macOS workflow. Hosted CI and push remain unverified; authentication unavailable, no retry.
verification.processes: All Core/compiler/native/audit sessions terminal. No main app launch; hidden alert windows explicitly closed. Final app/native receiver process audit empty. Receiver creates no private preference domains and modifies no general clipboard.
verification.limitations: Physical menu/confirmation/default-button interaction and signed sandbox execution remain unverified. Snapshot comparison is stronger than source endpoint checks and occurs after confirmation; it is not a cross-process lock. Native batches stop on the first command failure, while upstream reports failures and continues; partial-result reporting/recovery remains pending. Deletion does not roll back completed commands. General menu ordering/action coverage, concurrency, full RefLog revision menus/columns/geometry, Finder activation, complete dialog parity, updated genuine screenshots/manual, hosted publication and signed App Store distribution remain incomplete.
